name: Claw Attack
cardTexts: Player discards 1 card from their inventory
erratas: Player chooses which card to discard from inventory, the card chosen could either be a treasure or an item card.
If player has no card in inventory, this card does nothing.
Claw Attack only affects the current player in encounter.

name: Dragon Nest
cardTexts: Dragon's highest value treasure is worth x2
erratas: The modified value of a treasure affected by Dragon Nest counts towards a wager condition, Dragon Nest is then removed from the treasure if the player wins the wager.
Dragon Nest stays in the Dragon's hoard even after the treasure gets stolen or wagered by a player.
Dragon Nest immediately moves to the next applicable treasure in the Dragon's hoard when the original treasure has been removed from the Dragon's hoard.
Dragon Nest only stacks if there is only one treasure in Dragon's hoard.
House rule option: remove the ! icon modifier to lessen the difficulty

name: Hoarding
erratas: When drawn, immediately draws one treasure card from the same deck the player drew from and add it into the Dragon's hoard.
If the initial chosen deck is empty, draw from the other remaining treasure deck.

name: Dragon Glare
cardTexts: Reroll a Dragon's losing roll once this encounter
erratas: Reroll all the dice used in the initial roll when the Dragon loses. Player's dice are not rerolled.
Re-apply the effects of all other Dragon cards during the reroll that affects the dice roll value. Proc effects are resolved from the first roll.
When there are multiple Dragon Glare cards drawn, Dragon gets to re-roll for each Dragon Glare cards.

name: Defensive Tail
cardTexts: x2 to the Dragon's dice roll value
erratas: The total value of the Dragon's dice roll is multiplied by 2 during this encounter.
Re-apply Defensive Tail's effect during the entire encounter, even after re-rolling.

name: Dragon Roar
cardTexts: Each player tap all their items
erratas: 1️⃣ One usage items tapped due to Dragon Roar's effect are not discarded. They are untapped on their respective player's turn.
Dragon Roar affects all players, not just the player in the encounter.

name: Vicious Bite
cardTexts: Dragon steals 1 random card from the player
erratas: The card taken by the Dragon can either be a treasure or item card.
Determine the card taken by assigning values to each card and rolling a die / dice.
For example:
The player has 3 cards in their inventory, the value assignment is as follows
- The first card : 1 and 2
- The second card : 3 and 4
- The third card : 5 and 6
The Dragon then rolls a die and steals the card according to the value rolled.
Note: Item card in the Dragon's hoard is worth +100 to the Dragon

name: Dragon Eclipse
cardTexts: Add a treasure card into the encounter
erratas: The treasure card added is from the same initial treasure deck chosen by the player.
The new treasure card danger level gets added into the current encounter.
For example:
- Player draws a treasure with danger level 2 -> 2 Dragon cards need to be resolved before the dice roll
- The first Dragon card drawn is Dragon Eclipse and a treasure with danger level 3 is added into the encounter
- Danger level is now 2 + 3 = 5
- With the Dragon Eclipse's effect resolved, Player needs to resolve 4 more Dragon cards
- Winner of the encounter takes all treasure cards in the encounter

name: Dragon Stomp
cardTexts: Player discards 1 item card from their inventory
erratas: Player gets to choose which item to be discarded, if player has no item, this card does nothing.

name: Fire Breath
erratas: Player chooses which card to discard from inventory, the card chosen could either be a treasure or an item card.
If player has no card in inventory, this card does nothing.

name: Wing Gust
cardTexts: Dragon swaps lowest treasure with the player's highest
erratas: If either the Dragon or player has no treasure, this card does nothing.

name: Hard Scales
cardTexts: Players cannot use items in this encounter
erratas: All players are unable to use any item during this encounter, their items are not tapped due to this card.
